authority: apostila-cga-2026; second sweep round over strata C and D after amendments 01 and 02
method: scripts/build_sweep_queue.py over reports/precision-strata-wide.json, 665 occurrences read; every occurrence of each suspect form then read exhaustively
reason: Round two found twelve wrong events, a conflated definition, and the domain's most central concept left with no automatic form at all.

operations.why: Every occurrence is a fragment of an English compound the material quotes verbatim — `Net Asset Value`, `Asset Allocation`, `Asset-Liability Management`, `asset management`. None of them names an item of economic value.
Restores an automatic English anchor once the bare form is demoted.

`ativado` and `ativada`, the forms that actually mean enabled, occur zero times in this corpus, while `ativo` and `ativos` occur 544 times and every one of them is the noun `asset`. A generic system-state concept inherited from the controlled-language core was holding the domain's central term hostage: because both concepts claimed the surface, the collision demoter — correctly, given what it was told — sent BOTH to review, so `entity.asset` matched nothing automatically in Portuguese.
`devidamente habilitado pela CVM` means licensed by the regulator, not that a function is available for operation.
Held at review only by the collision withdrawn above. Every corpus occurrence is the noun.
364 occurrences, all the noun in the plural.
`a Butterfly pode se configurar de duas formas` means it takes two shapes, not that a system is being set up.

operations.definition: The placement of fund shares with investors, including the public offering and its settlement.
operations.why: The definition read `the statistical spread of outcomes, OR the placement of fund shares with investors`. Under that wording nothing could ever be a false positive, which is why the sweep reported none — but normalising both senses onto one identifier destroys exactly the distinction the registry exists to preserve. Splitting is the repair; the second sense becomes its own concept below.
Allocation across maturities, across managers or across obligations is not the placement of shares with investors.

record.definition: The statistical spread of possible outcomes over their probabilities.
record.source: CGA 2026 course material, adjudicated against corpus contexts

en: The VaR uses the normal distribution as its descriptive parameter.
pt-BR: O VaR utiliza a distribuição normal como parâmetro descritivo.

en: Do not use probability distribution for the placement of fund shares.
pt-BR: Não use distribuição de probabilidades para a distribuição de cotas.

operations.why: The seven statistical occurrences the conflated definition was absorbing. Its labels are all collocations, so it takes the statistical sense without contesting bare `distribuição`, which keeps anchoring the placement sense fourteen times as `distribuição de cotas`.
